create_sequential: create a sparseconvnet Sequential module to chain layers with custom add, insert, and append methods
build_checkpointed_sequential: build a CheckpointedSequential module that uses gradient checkpointing during forward pass
test_input_spatial_size: test the input_spatial_size method to compute output spatial dimensions through the module chain
run_reweight: run the reweight method to normalize features and adjust module weights and biases
run_rebias: run the rebias method to reset module biases based on the mean of normalized features
